meta.title: My Minimalist Apartment Tour! (IKEA)
meta.description:
SUBSCRIBE IF YOU LIKE! AND FOLLOW ME ON INSTAGRAM (@8thWeekday) IF YOU LIKE! AND IF YOU LIKE THEN LIKE!

So look at me! Redoing my room a little bit! Am I an interior decorator? No! NEVER! But I hauled my little self down to Ikea and grabbed some tiny furniture for my apartment room! NEXT STOP IS REDOING MY ENTIRE APARTMENT!

Okay so this isn't really a HUGE apartment tour but it's still my apartment ROOM tour in Hoboken New Jersey that is mostly now covered in Ikea furniture. I really wanted an apartment in Manhattan or Brooklyn or somewhere really NYC and COOL but honestly I was homeless for a little bit and really wanted somewhere to live. Also at the time I wasn't sure how New York City really worked and I thought that wherever I went I'd have to pay like $500 a month for parking and I couldn't swing that. My current apartment though isn't too expensive! $1100 a month for a 3br that I of course split with two other people.

The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered.
